newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 871,200 MT were 32 percent below the week earlier and 5 percent under the 4-week average.

The primary buyer was Japan (534,300 MT, includes 521,800 new sales, 25,400 destination changes, 12,900 foreign purchases/cancellations), followed by Taiwan (169,600 MT, includes 117,100 new sales, 52,500 destination changes) and Turkey (122,900 MT, includes 20,700 new sales, 102,200 destination changes). Decreases were reported for unknown destinations (143,400 MT).

Exports of 926,700 MT were 15 percent lower than the prior week and the 4-week average. The principal destinations were Japan (226,500 MT), Taiwan (169,700 MT), Turkey (112,900 MT), and South Korea (109,800 MT).
